evals.prompt: Set up the type scale, spacing, and colors for our new B2B analytics app. Brand color is #0F766E. We need light and dark mode.
evals.expected_output: A compact foundations spec: 16px base (or justified 14px for dense views) with a 1.2-ish product ratio and 6-8 sizes, line-heights and measure, a 4px spacing scale with relationship tiers, a 12-step OKLCH ramp around the brand hue plus a tinted neutral ramp, semantic roles mapped for light and dark, dark surfaces around L 0.13-0.18 with lighter elevation, and a contrast table for every text/surface pair.
expectations: Type scale states a base size and a ratio between 1.125 and 1.25 for app UI
Colors are authored in OKLCH with semantic role names (e.g. bg, fg, fg-muted, accent, border)
Dark theme is defined as its own values rather than an inversion, with lighter surfaces for elevation
Includes a contrast check listing text/surface pairs against 4.5:1 and non-text against 3:1
Neutrals are tinted toward the brand hue rather than pure grey

evals.prompt: Our hero headline uses font-size: 6vw and it looks tiny on phones and huge on my ultrawide. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Replaces pure vw with clamp() using rem min/max and a rem + vw preferred value, shows the slope/intercept calculation, keeps max <= 2.5x min, and explains the zoom (WCAG 1.4.4) issue.
expectations: Uses clamp() with rem-based minimum and maximum
Preferred value includes a rem term plus a vw term
Maximum is no more than 2.5 times the minimum
Mentions that pure vw sizing fails browser zoom or WCAG 1.4.4

evals.prompt: Cards inside our modal have 20px radius and the images inside them have 20px radius too with 8px padding. Something looks off.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the nested-radius problem and applies inner = outer - padding (12px), optionally suggests a radius scale.
expectations: States the rule inner radius = outer radius minus padding
Recommends 12px for the inner image radius

evals.prompt: Pick a visual style for my indie game's website. Something with personality.
evals.expected_output: Near-miss: this is an aesthetic-direction request; routes to design-taste (direction presets, signature move) rather than only giving scales and contrast numbers.
expectations: Recommends or uses the design-taste workflow for choosing the direction
Does not answer only with type scales, spacing, and contrast values
